ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure is a structural schematic diagram of an insect, in which long slender antennae, a segmented body, wings, and especially thick hind legs bent backward can be seen; the figure also has multiple drawings of the same type of insect with labeled or highlighted parts. Reasoning: The features of this insect, which has strong jumping hind legs, wings, and antennae, are consistent with a locust/grasshopper, so the figure depicts a grasshopper.
